post.description: Verify configured GitHub repository/default branch and ancestry through a read-only repository connection; never fetch a caller-supplied network host. Missing authorization or unverifiable ancestry fails closed. First publication requires matching consent; 20 MiB body, 1000 files and 10000 parsed items are aggregate limits. Existing legacy hub endpoints remain separately unchanged.
